[[Allania Jakien]]'s '''mother''' lived on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. She worked in the [[Holiday Towers Hotel and Casino|Holiday Towers]] [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] and escaped the [[Occupation of Bespin|take over]] of Cloud City by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], fleeing with her family aboard a crowded [[Transport/Legends|transport]].
